decision: Meaning-bearing or pragmatic variants are a legitimate different input contract from orthographic alias cycling, and this distinction is already represented in the reserve and in1222. No new complete22-sign writer was obtained by calling a variant polite, emphatic or evidential. Retain one concrete existing rule,949, without a new card or experiment; its input information and spatial costs remain explicit.

one_existing_human_rule.input: An author's ordinary complete word sequence, punctuation and explicit audible-emphasis bit for each word, supplied before any target comparison. The writer is not choosing bits to equalize frequencies.
one_existing_human_rule.written_rule: Write all ordinary words in full. A taught broad gap before a word marks emphasis1; a narrow gap marks emphasis0. Both retain the source word boundary. At a physical line start, the corresponding indentation carries the same bit; a line wrap alone changes neither the bit nor the source words. Blank rows mark paragraphs.
one_existing_human_rule.reader: Read the words and punctuation in the known ordinary language and recover each emphasis bit from its preceding gap/indent. Broad gaps also delimit the rule's primary groups. No invisible original sentence is needed for the Roman teaching lesson.

new_invented_complete_hand_example_using.gap_key: [N] denotes the taught narrow gap and [W] the taught broad gap/initial indent; these labels explain the actual spatial marks and are not extra native glyph values.
new_invented_complete_hand_example_using.reading_A: Mara wärmt den Krug nicht. Read Mara and nicht with the author's marked emphasis.
new_invented_complete_hand_example_using.reading_B: The same complete negative assertion, now with emphasis on Mara and Krug.
new_invented_complete_hand_example_using.preserved: The named participant, ordinary predicate, object expression, written negation and final punctuation remain. The emphasis difference is additional overt information.
new_invented_complete_hand_example_using.not_inferred: Neither emphasis pattern means only Mara, only this vessel, or that something else was warmed. Such exclusive alternatives are not implied merely by emphasis and would have to remain explicit ordinary wording.
new_invented_complete_hand_example_using.status: An informed hand illustration of the existing Roman module, not a new source sample, blind readback, native value or statistical test.

one_existing_human_rule.paid_learning_memory: The ordinary language and word script, two visible gap grades, a margin/indent convention, paragraph separation and preservation across wrapping. The source contributes one explicit emphasis bit per word. Broad gaps consume page space; no letter is saved. No alternation counter or private reference table is used.
one_existing_human_rule.remaining_scope: The raw does not supply a22-working-sign body script, measured handwriting tolerances, historical emphasis annotations or overwide-word continuation. It therefore remains incomplete as a proposed native/statistical writer. This review does not reopen that old missing component or request another width audit.
one_existing_human_rule.why_it_is_relevant: This is a concrete communicative reason for the same spelled word to have a different grouping role, without a state invented solely to scatter frequencies. It is not a word-spelling alias mechanism and cannot be inserted into the old word/group comparison without declaring the new spatial channel.

meaningful_inflection_was_already_tested.actual_contract: Ordinary lemma, UPOS, all published FEATS, traditional mood/tense, declared unknown-form fallback and retained punctuation in original lexical sequence. The inverse is that projected analysis stream, explicitly not the original known-word FORM spelling or every meaning.
meaningful_inflection_was_already_tested.readable_function_examples_from_report: First versus third person of dico and genitive versus accusative of operatio were retained as different analyses. These are learned grammatical differences, not arbitrary per-letter ticks.
meaningful_inflection_was_already_tested.retained_result: The preregistered joint source screen failed. The report also retains one book's necessary-frequency pass, which is not a whole-writer or glyph-table success and cannot replace the all-book decision.
meaningful_inflection_was_already_tested.important_scope: It is inaccurate to say that the project only considered byte-preserving aliases. It is equally inaccurate to infer from the1222 conjunction's failure that all meaningful inflection or every learned language is excluded. Feature bundles can split a FORM and merge several spellings; the old universal two-forms-per-FORM premise was explicitly not assumed in1222.

necessary_statistical_distinction.same_message_aliases: If a fixed input word can yield at most two output whole-word forms, the two-form capacity bound remains valid whether the selector is called spelling, emphasis, politeness or a grammatical choice. Giving it a sensible name does not change the combinatorics.
necessary_statistical_distinction.genuinely_changed_input: If the input includes independently specified grammatical/pragmatic features and the writer distinguishes them, compare complete input units such as (lexeme,features,role,mode), with exactly the features actually encoded. This can be a different source projection and cannot be assumed to inherit an at-most-two-form map from an unannotated FORM.
necessary_statistical_distinction.information_cost: The features must come from the declared authored message or a fixed public analysis. They cannot be assigned after seeing desired output counts. They must be recoverable from actual output signals; an unrecorded source annotation is not a written distinction.
necessary_statistical_distinction.no_quantitative_claim: Nothing here proves that such distinctions occur often enough, spread over the right words or meet any target statistic. No new profile or count was computed.

provenance_and_commitment_not_new_cards.boundary: Reported versus directly observed provenance was already proposed. Its review rejects the claim that a content/topic reading must show no provenance association and requires independently specified status plus a distinguishing scope prediction. This old native-facing proposal is not a complete human writer and is not reopened by naming a new evidential suffix.

Asserted versus conditional/proposed status is already in the reserve. It is not identical to information provenance: a reported statement can be assertive, and an observed event can support a conditional. The unchanged card is a hypothesis with unbound status evidence, not a complete paid notation. No duplicate variant is added.

selection_boundary: The concrete clarification is to preserve the distinction between a fixed message's spelling alternatives and actually different declared grammatical/pragmatic messages.949 supplies a humanly understandable example, while1222 shows that the project has already tested one genuinely different analysis representation. Neither licenses arbitrary new feature bits, a new marker table or an automatic source change. No fresh complete physical writer is selected in this block.
retrieval_and_access: Live route/composition topic; bounded emphasis/evidential searches and exact idea cards;949 raw,033/070 originals and033 later primary review;1222 method/report and followup navigation; retained1202 primary from the preceding review. No new source, raw native text/profile/image, source count, encoder, fitting, other agent, root file, ledger or state edit. Only this own note is written.
stop: No new RAW card warranted; bounded block complete.
